issue.title: `cronetHttpNoPlay=true` build broken in Flutter 3.44.0: Namespace 'org.chromium.net' is used in multiple modules and/or libraries

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: Incorrect behavior (everything from a crash to more subtle misbehavior)

issue.body_html:
Hi,

building an apk with --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true is broken with the new Gradle version in Flutter 3.44.0. Building without that option (so, native cronet) works fine.

Error message: [org.chromium.net:cronet-embedded:141.7340.3] ~/.gradle/caches/9.1.0/transforms/2e5c6e1ae32483156f8fb1f259ac32ce/transformed/cronet-embedded-141.7340.3/AndroidManifest.xml Error: Namespace 'org.chromium.net' is used in multiple modules and/or libraries: org.chromium.net:cronet-embedded:141.7340.3, org.chromium.net:httpengine-native-provider:141.7340.3, org.chromium.net:cronet-common:141.7340.3, org.chromium.net:cronet-api:141.7340.3, org.chromium.net:cronet-shared:141.7340.3. Please ensure that all modules and libraries have a unique namespace. For more information, See https://developer.android.com/studio/build/configure-app-module#set-namespace

Minimal example:

$ flutter create cronetbug
$ cd cronetbug
$ flutter pub add cronet_http
$ flutter build apk --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true

issue.title: fix(cronet): avoid cronet namespace duplication
issue.body_html:
Worked around a cronet bug where multiple packages have the same. See the comment in pkgs/cronet_http/android/build.gradle for details.

Also upgrades package:jnigen to 1.0.1 to avoid a CI failure because the CI would version solve against package:jnigen 1.0.1, which generates slightly different code to 1.0.0.

Fixes #1932
